description: 兵对兵①：对立位制胜 — 白王在侧翼占据对立位，强行突破

intro.popup_en: Winning with the opposition: the white king on b5 and black king on f4 are not on the same file. By taking the opposition, White can force the d-pawn forward.
intro.popup: 💡 对立位制胜：白王 b5 与黑王 f4 不在同一列，白方争夺对立位后可强行推进 d 兵。

outro.popup_en: White wins. Once the white king takes the opposition, the d-pawn cannot be stopped and will promote.
outro.popup: ✅ 结论：白胜！ 白王占据对立位后，d 兵无法被拦截，顺利升变。

moves.popup_en: 1. Kc5: the white king approaches and contests the opposition.
1...Ke4: the black king tries to stop the pawn.
2. Kc4: the white king takes the opposition, allowing the d-pawn to advance safely.
moves.popup: 2.Kc4 — 白王取得对立位，d 兵可安全前进。

moves.popup_en: 2...Ke5: the black king has no choice but to give up the d-file.
moves.popup: 2...Ke5 — 黑王别无选择，让出 d 线。
